Ivy (CS): Quick Day0 for Spectral private/VPC onboarding. Top open items from preflight: egress allowlist, runtime SA + bucket read perms, KMS key ACL + rotation cadence, and audit-log ingestion to customer Splunk. @Lars can you pick up firewall + SA networking? :wave:
Lars (NetOps): Yep. What SA name will Spectral provision and where are model artifacts stored?
Eve (Spectral): We will create `spectral-rw-sa` in project `spectral-prod`. Models in GCS `gs://spectral-models-prod`.
Lars (NetOps): Plan: grant `roles/storage.objectViewer` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` to the SA. For egress, please whitelist `35.196.0.0/14` and `34.120.0.0/14` on ports 443 and 15002 (metrics).
Mina (Security): KMS notes: rotation quarterly. Key resource: `projects/spectral-prod/locations/global/keyRings/spec-kr/cryptoKeys/spec-key-7`. Policy must bind `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to Redwood runtime SA and `roles/cloudkms.viewer` to `group:spectral-security@spectral.example.com`. Also we require signed audit entries (HMAC-SHA256) and retention 365 days.
Tom (SRE): For Splunk ingestion: we require mTLS (client cert) and TLS1.2+. Endpoint? Also send a small sample JSON event so we can validate the parsing pipeline.
Eve (Spectral): Splunk endpoint: `https://splunk.spectral.example/services/collector`. Sample event: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-15T12:00:00Z","service":"spec-agent","event":{"type":"model.pull","model":"spec-4b","status":"ok","size":23145}}
```
orca-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/spectral-week0 - includes onboarding checklist and keys doc.
Ivy (CS): Action items: 1) Eve to provision SA and upload certs + sample events to runbook; 2) Lars to apply firewall rules & IAM after SA exists; 3) Mina to publish KMS policy snippet and sign off; 4) Tom to validate Splunk ingestion and HMAC header `X-Event-Signature`. Target: EOD next day PST. Any blockers? :thumbsup:
Eve (Spectral): :thumbsup: We'll provision today and DM the CSR to secure handoff doc.
Ivy (CS): Thanks team — I will update the runbook with owners/ETAs and follow up first thing tomorrow.
